paper_title: The first search for bosonic super-WIMPs with masses up to 1 MeV/c$^2$ with GERDA
notes: GERDA search for keV-scale bosonic super-WIMPs (60 keV - 1 MeV) via axioelectric absorption in HPGe detectors, 58.9 kg-yr exposure. Paper sets 90% credible interval upper limits on both g_ae (pseudoscalar/ALP) and alpha'/alpha (dark photon kinetic mixing); AxionElectron chosen per the g_ae result, consistent with pre-analysis hint. Full exclusion curves are shown only in Fig. 3 (no numerical table); the only explicit numerical value in the text is g_ae < 3e-12 at 150 keV/c^2, which is the single point emitted. The dark photon limit alpha'/alpha < 6.5e-24 at 150 keV is also quoted but not included since coupling_type is AxionElectron. Limits are strongest direct constraints for masses 120 keV - 1 MeV.
